长描述: 原版定死空爆出9个子武器，分别攻击3x3范围内的每个格子，现在可以用下句进行自定义。 Ares新增：

单独设定的递光武器，原先使用副武器，现在可以与副武器相互独立，默认原规则 但如果你要递光武器不再拥有那一坨硬编码逻辑，例如需要递光激光可以自定义颜色，那么你需要使用上面两句重新指定递光武器 以下标签可以被用来定义支援时的光束武器，也就是上面两句设定的那个，都是常规武器通用的标签，只是部分在此有专门用于递光的特性 [PrismForwarding.SupportWeapon] Range= (integer - cells) 支援半径，Ares设定为默认主武器射程+1，以便建筑的实际支援范围能够与建筑放置时的指示环范围相切合 MinimumRange= (integer - cells) 最小半径 ROF= (integer - frames) 支援速率，默认[General]►PrismSupportDelay=的值 Report= (sound) 支援声音 IsLaser= (boolean) 是否是激光特效 IsElectricBolt= (boolean) 是否是EBolt特效 IsRadBeam= (boolean) 是否是辐射波特效 压缩包里有个工具可以用于计算 文件地址为Ares原包解压后的.\Documentation\_downloads\PrismForwarding.xls 在20400prosperous.ys168.com中已有汉化版本
英文注释: In the original game, the [PrismSupport] weapon was never referenced directly, and the Secondary weapon of the Prism Tower was only ever referenced to get the Range that towers could support over. In Ares, the Secondary weapon of the Prism Tower is not referenced at all. Instead, we use PrismForwarding.SupportWeapon to explicitly reference a weapon object from which to get additional settings for the support beam. It isn’t necessary to specify a support weapon - default values will be used if you don’t specify one.

长描述: 设置IsSimpleDeployer=yes的单位部署变换成什么单位。变换发生在单位部署完成后，也就是DeployingAnim播放完之后。默认none。 部署后，单位是可动的，不像武装直升机那样部署后锁在那个格子里，如果你希望锁在那个格子请在Phobos环境下使用Speed=0禁用移动 DeployToLand=yes也支持，DeployingAnim也可以播放，而且DeployToLand=no也可以用DeployDir 如果你想要让一个地面载具变成Jumpjet载具后立即起飞那么这个Jumpjet载具是需要有DeployToLand=yes的 若不想保留这条，那么再走一步Convert.Land或Convert.Water变成另一个DeployToLand=no的Jumpjet即可 与升级转换有同样的限制，除了： - 因为这种变换一定是发生在地图上的，所以Size的变化是允许的。 悬浮单位也可以部署变形，如果DeployToLand=yes的话，单位会平滑地着陆；否则闪现到地面上。 虽然Convert.Deploy是个TechnoType通用的语句，但是IsSimpleDeployer仅限VehicleType 因此步兵无法直接使用Ares的这个逻辑来部署变形 通过脚本变换单位
英文注释: The type a IsSimpleDeployer=yes unit deploys into. This converts the type after deploying completed, and after the optional DeployingAnim has finished playing. Defaults to none.

长描述: 当单位执行脚本时变换成什么单位。默认none。 增强版WaterImage

长描述: 当单位移动到海滩或水格上变换成什么单位。默认none。
英文注释: The type to convert to when a unit moves onto a beach or water cell. Defaults to none.

长描述: 当单位移动到既不是海滩也不是水的格子上变换成什么单位。默认none。 以上单元格类型检测不检查单位是否贴地，也就是说一个 Jumpjet 载具只要正下方是对应类型的单元格也可以移动进那个单元格后直接从天而降变成陆地载具 全部支持更改Locomotor，但是如果在移动中更改Locomotor那么单位会卡住，直到你重新下达指令 如果你只是想要更换素材 例如到水上使用一个悬浮效果 那就不如直接把浮动做进HVA里来表现这个效果了 JumpjetHeight等数据不会及时刷新，但你可以依靠一个Hover载具作为中介来刷掉Jumpjet相关的参数，以此实现Jumpjet变Jumpjet的数据刷新同时不让中介单位那一步把单位一下摁到地面

长描述: 这个单位是什么单位的假单位，用于快捷键输出价值时的计算。默认none。 当使用快捷键查询伤残程度（原版快捷键 U）和经验等级（原版快捷键 Y）时会提示所选单位的价值，如果假单位与原单位的价格设定得不一致可能导致暴露，于是就有了这个逻辑。

长描述: 这个单位被逆向工程后，作为什么单位被给予。如果不设置则为该单位本身。默认不设置。

长描述: 指定某个驾驶者才能操作，_ANY_的话是任意驾驶者都行，默认none，不需要驾驶者 这个单位必须至少有一个乘客位置，建筑则需要设置InfantryAbsorb=yes或UnitAbsorb=yes 建筑没有操作者只会表现出无法使用武器，但是诸如生产，超武，反部署，雷达等不会受到影响 需要注意的是AI不会用这样的功能，所以应该避免AI造需要操作者的单位

长描述: 指定有多少额外的建造前提，默认0，也就是原有的Prerequisite [Unit]►Prerequisite.List#= (list of BuildingTypes (where # is the 1-based index of the prerequisite list, the maximum specified by Prerequisite.Lists)) 指定新的建造前提，想设置多少都可以（根据Prerequisite.Lists决定） 另有一个 Prerequisite.List0=可以覆盖原版 Prerequisite=使用，这样更符合人类用户的习惯，即除了原语句外的新增项从 1 开始，也与 Prerequisite.Lists 设定的数量刚好对应 也就是 [UnitType] Prerequisite=YACNST Prerequisite.Lists=1 Prerequisite.List0=GAPILE,GATECH Prerequisite.List1=NAHAND,NATECH 那么在不考虑TechLevel和Owner等限制条件的情况下满足（同时拥有 GAPILE 与 GATECH）或（同时拥有 NAHAND 与 NATECH）即可建造 注意： Lists指定的多少额外条件 也就是 Prerequisite.List0/Prerequisite= 先决条件 Prerequisite.Lists=2 额外先决条件的数量有2个 Prerequisite.List1=XXX Prerequisite.List2=YYY List#的最大序号与Lists的值完全对应，强迫症一本满足 此外，如果留空则相当于某个条件写了任意条件，例如这里Prerequisite.List0=和Prerequisite=一个都没有指定的话，会被认为它们已经被满足，导致只要TechLevel等其他条件满足就直接允许生产，而Prerequisite.List1、Prerequisite.List2的内容根本不会看（毕竟已经满足条件了）
英文注释: Specifies how many extra Prerequisite lists complimentary to the one default list are available. Defaults to 0.

英文注释: Determines the percent chance that each of the unit’s passengers (if any) will survive. Rookie/Veteran/Elite refer to the veteran level of the transport unit – a unit with a higher veteran level could be made to have a greater (or lesser) chance of allowing its passengers to survive. 英文注释: Specifies whether or not an object of this type will be destroyed by EMP weapons. Use an integer to set the exact EMP duration this unit has to exceed to get destroyed. Positive values will destroy the unit if the number of EMP frames exceeds this value. yes equals 1, meaning immediately. Negative values will destroy the unit only if is currently in-air. inair equals -1, meaning immediately if in air. A value of zero will disable this feature. no equals 0. Defaults to inair, destroying all units if they are in the air the instant the EMP hits. Note Parachuting units and units being lifted or lowered by a Magnetron do not count as being in air. Only exceeding their positive threshold (if set) will kill them.

英文注释: The amount of hitpoints restored when self healing. Cannot be less than 0. If defined, overrides the veterancy specific tags below. Defaults to 1.

长描述: 在单位受到攻击之后多长时间不能自愈，用于做脱战一定时间后才能回血。默认0。
英文注释: Defines how long after a damaging attack a unit will not be able to self heal. Healing weapons do not trigger this delay. Use 0 to disable this. Defaults to 0.

长描述: 单位的工业工厂倍率，最终的折扣将会乘以工业工厂本身的倍率，完全支持-1.0到1.0，0.0使倍率无效。默认1.0 例子：如果工业工厂倍率是0.6，单位倍率为0.5，那么最后的价值将会是成本的0.8倍。换句话说：如果一个单位的价格减少了60%，乘数只有补助一半的成本，最终价格将在原始成本的80%。 AlexB的奇思妙想，搞得也太复杂了，这里以我的见解解释一下：假设一个1000块的单位，它的工业工厂倍率是0.5，而工业工厂将会使所有单位降价到原价的60%，即0.6，则降价的部分是原价的40%，乘以单位本身的倍率，则实际降价20%，最终单位价格是800，给个公式方便理解。 单位最终价格=单位原价-[单位原价x（1-工业工厂倍率）x单位倍率]
英文注释: The effect of the respective CostBonus tag for this type is multiplied by this value to either increase, decrease, or nullify the effect. Fully supported values range from -1.0 to reverse the effect to 1.0 to not apply the effect. 0.0 nullifies the bonus. Defaults to 1.0. Note Values beyond 1.0 can potentially cause the cost to drop to zero, if the effect of the product of all cost bonuses is multiplied by a too large value. This is because the effect of this multiplier is linear.

长描述: 微观开火速度倍数，默认[CombatDamage]►BerserkROFMultiplier
英文注释: The multiplier applied when this unit is berserking. Smaller means faster firing. Defaults to [CombatDamage]►BerserkROFMultiplier.

长描述: 每花费1000块钱所使用的分钟数。默认 [General]►BuildSpeed。 如果设置了，带有Wall=yes的建筑将不会再应用WallBuildSpeedCoefficient。
英文注释: The time in minutes it takes to produce an object which costs 1000 credits. Defaults to [General]►BuildSpeed. Note If set, WallBuildSpeedCoefficient will not be applied to Wall=yes buildings any more, because BuildTime.Speed is taken as final value.

长描述: 如果设置了，建筑的建造时间将使用这里设置的Cost进行计算，而不使用建筑自己的Cost。默认Cost。 建筑的建造时间=(Cost/1000)*BuildSpeed 低电力时：
英文注释: If set, the build time is calculated as if this item cost this much, instead of using actual Cost. Defaults to Cost.

长描述: 低电力时的建造时间惩罚倍数。默认[General]►LowPowerPenaltyModifier=的值
英文注释: The penalty to apply to the build time in low power situations. Defaults to [General]►LowPowerPenaltyModifier.

长描述: 低电力时生产速度的最小值。默认[General]►MinLowPowerProductionSpeed=的值。
英文注释: The minimum production speed when power is low. The resulting low power modifier will not be lower than this. Defaults to [General]►MinLowPowerProductionSpeed.

英文注释: The factor multiplied by the build time per additional factory of the same type. Defaults to [General]►MultipleFactory.

英文注释: The list of stealable technology types that must be stolen before this object can be built. See Stolen Technology for more information.

长描述: 如果该值大于零，规定了该单位在空中时，计划要给该单位几帧的动画，AirRate覆盖WalkRate与IdleRate，若该值为零，则禁用AirRate，默认为0
英文注释: If higher than 0, defines after how many frames the unit’s animation is to be advanced to the next frame when the unit is in air. AirRate takes precedence over WalkRate and IdleRate. 0 disables AirRate. Defaults to 0.

长描述: 把这个单位归类于该选择组里，选择组名字不能太长（不高于30个字母），比如你可以把三种工程师都标为ENGINEER，这样选择任意一个工程师就能全选三种工程师

Note Check that you don’t accidentally use an existing ID of a probably unrelated type as group name. This would include this type in this selection group, if it doesn’t have GroupAs set to some other value itself.

英文注释: Defines how many frames after the previous effect subsides the AttachEffect is recreated on the unit itself. Negative values do not renew the effect. Defaults to 0 (immediately).

英文注释: The weapon index to switch to when there is no ammo left. This will override the normal weapon selection and only allow this weapon to be selected. Valid values 0 for the primary weapon and 1 for the secondary. Use -1 to not switch weapons. Defaults to -1. Note This tag cannot override the DeployFireWeapon enabled by DeployFire=yes on VehicleTypes and InfantryTypes.

长描述: 如果弹药等于低于该值，则启用NoAmmoWeapon。默认0

长描述: 对Harvester=yes的单位默认为[General]►TiberiumLongScan 对于奴隶矿场默认为[General]►SlaveMinerLongScan

长描述: 对Harvester=yes的单位默认为[General]►TiberiumShortScan 对于奴隶矿场默认为[General]►SlaveMinerShortScan 对于奴隶默认为[General]►SlaveMinerSlaveScan

英文注释: Overrides the distance to consider too far to reserve a refinery. Requires Harvester=yes. Defaults to [General]►ChronoHarvTooFarDistance for Teleporter=yes units, otherwise to [General]►HarvesterTooFarDistance.

长描述: 给奴隶矿场用的。默认[General]►SlaveMinerKickFrameDelay 判定为TooFar后奴隶停止采矿的时间，用-1来禁用此功能，始终不停工
英文注释: Overrides the interval in which to wake up the Slave Miner. For Slave Miner unis only. Use -1 to not wake up the Slave Miner automatically. Defaults to [General]►SlaveMinerKickFrameDelay.

长描述: 在仅吸取单个建筑电力的情况下使用，控制吸多少电，如果是正值，那么表示最多能吸多少电；如果是负值，那么表示至少能吸多少电，默认0。 计数顺序为建筑 Power= 值→单位 Drain.Amount= 值→建筑 Drain.Amount= 值 例如：使用镭射浮幽吸取 Power=500 的电厂。 先用建筑 Power 和镭射浮幽的 Drain.Amount 进行计算： 若镭射浮幽 Drain.Amount=-1000，吸取 1000 电； 若镭射浮幽 Drain.Amount=0，吸取建筑产生的 500 电； 若镭射浮幽 Drain.Amount=200，只吸取 200 电。 然后把算出来的值与建筑的 Drain.Amount 进行下一步计算： 若建筑自身设置 Drain.Amount=-600，则被吸取的电量不会低于 600； 若建筑自身设置 Drain.Amount=800，则被吸取的电量不会超过 800。 最后得出结果： 抛射体

If positive, this is the maximum amount of power drained. If negative, this is the minimum amount of power drained. Defaults to 0. The start value is the victim building’s Power, then the draining unit’s Drain.Amount is applied, and finally the drained building’s Drain.Amount.

英文注释: The list of countries whose factories can build this object. If empty, every country is allowed to build this object. Otherwise, players need to own at least one factory built by a country in this list or the plans of at least one of these countries to produce it.

长描述: 决定此超武会偏向于发射在哪个，由地图触发行为设定的格，默认取决于Type=. 有效值为： "none":无偏向 "offensive": 偏向于由地图触发行为设定的侵略性格子。135号行为设定这种格子，136号行为移除这种格子 "defensive": 偏向于由地图触发行为设定的防御性格子。 SW.AITargeting约束条件 约束条件，即超级武器的发射所需环境。他们中有些是人为的(比如，即使AI没有选定敌人，搜猎者也可以发射，这说不过去), 有些是客观的(如果优先级最高的敌人基地成为了目标，但是AI还没有选择任何目标，那么就没有可以发射的地点). 如果没有适宜的约束条件，那么超武的图标会成为灰色（仅限于使用AITargeting时）。如果在约束条件的范围内超武找不到可以发射的目标，那么玩家会得到一条发射失败的文字回馈。
英文注释: The preference overrides the actual targeting. As long as these overrides are set, the super weapons will prefer these set targets. Defaults depend on the Type=.

长描述: 填此超武所需的发射约束环境，多个约束条件用逗号隔开。默认取决于Type=. 有效值为： "none":没有约束条件 "offensive_cell_clear":地图触发行为135没有设定侵略性格子时 "defensive_cell_clear":地图触发行为140没有设定防御性格子时 "offensive_cell_set":直到地图触发行为135设定了侵略性格子时 "defensive_cell_set":直到地图触发行为140设定了防御性格子时 "enemy":当发射方已经选定了一个所属方为敌人时 "lightningstorm_inactive":当没有任何闪电风暴处于发射状态时 "dominator_inactive":当没有任何心灵控制处于发射状态时 "attacked":当发射方被攻击时 "lowpower":当发射方处于低电力状态时 以下约束环境对玩家无效： "lightningstorm_inactive"，因为玩家会在闪电风暴激活时得到一条发射失败的回馈信息 "dominator_inactive"，因为玩家会在心灵控制激活时得到一条发射失败的回馈信息 "attacked"，因为这是辅助AI使用的，玩家能够正确的判别何时应该发设 "lowpower"，同上 默认值表： Ares3.0新增的LowPowerAttack、LowPower、Attack不在表上，可视为有限制条件的NoTarget作为参考 然而即便满足AITargeting，Westwood也限制AI要有一个106-112帧范围的随机延迟后才会去真正发射超武 Phobos 已允许设定该延迟，详见 Phobos 文档 范围限制 可以设置超武的射程，以超武建筑为中心，超过其发射范围就不能发射超武。

长描述: 飞机数目默认1，可以一架飞机抛下一串，而不是原版那样每类兵种一架飞机，也可以单独设定超武的每一个飞机 以下标签用于ParaDrop.Count>=2的情况 [SuperWeapon]►ParaDrop.ID.PlaneX.*= ID 是国家或阵营名 ，如果要为所有阵营设置，ID部分不用写 X 是正整数，针对从2到 Count指定值的飞机单独设置。第一架飞机不需要用 PlaneX *代表上面的Types、Num、Aircraft这些 [SuperWeapon]►ParaDrop.Country.PlaneX.*=国家设定 [SuperWeapon]►ParaDrop.Side.PlaneX.*=阵营设定X [SuperWeapon]►ParaDrop.PlaneX.*= 超武默认飞机X [SuperWeapon]►ParaDrop.Country.*= 国家默认飞机X [SuperWeapon]►ParaDrop.Side.*= 阵营默认飞机X [SuperWeapon]►ParaDrop.*= 超武的默认飞机 [Country]►ParaDrop.*=国家默认飞机 [Side]►ParaDrop.*= 阵营默认飞机 [General]►*=全局默认飞机 这Ares官方的写法还真是…… 例如： ParaDrop.Russians.Plane3.Types=BORIS 用于设置Russians国家第3架飞机的内容为BORIS ParaDrop.Nod.Aircraft=SPLANE 用于设置Nod(原版苏军)阵营的飞机类型使用SPLANE 这个功能就是同一个超武根据使用的国家和阵营不同使用不同的数量或类型的飞机投下不同的单位 写个示例吧，比如说 Type=ParaDrop ParaDrop.Count=3 ParaDrop.GDI.Aircraft=ORCA ParaDrop.GDI.Types=MTNK ParaDrop.GDI.Num=2 ParaDrop.GDI.Plane2.Aircraft=ORCA ParaDrop.GDI.Plane2.Types=MTNK ParaDrop.GDI.Plane2.Num=2 ParaDrop.GDI.Plane3.Aircraft=PDPLANE ParaDrop.GDI.Plane3.Types=SREF ParaDrop.GDI.Plane3.Num=1 ParaDrop.Alliance.Aircraft=ORCA ParaDrop.Alliance.Types=MTNK ParaDrop.Alliance.Num=1 ParaDrop.Alliance.Plane2.Aircraft=BEAG ParaDrop.Alliance.Plane2.Types=SREF ParaDrop.Alliance.Plane2.Num=1 ParaDrop.Alliance.Plane3.Aircraft=PDPLANE ParaDrop.Alliance.Plane3.Types=MGTK ParaDrop.Alliance.Plane3.Num=1 ParaDrop.Nod.Aircraft=PDPLANE ParaDrop.Nod.Types=HTNK ParaDrop.Nod.Num=3 ParaDrop.Nod.Plane2.Aircraft=PDPLANE ParaDrop.Nod.Plane2.Types=HTNK ParaDrop.Nod.Plane2.Num=3 ParaDrop.Nod.Plane3.Aircraft=PDPLANE ParaDrop.Nod.Plane3.Types=HTNK ParaDrop.Nod.Plane3.Num=3 盟军第一架飞机是入侵者第二架飞机是入侵者第三架是运输机，然后投下2*灰熊，2*灰熊，1*光棱 韩国第一架飞机是入侵者第二架飞机用的黑鹰第三架是运输机，然后投下1*灰熊，1*光棱，1*幻影 苏军第一架飞机是运输机第二架飞机也是运输机第三架还是它，然后投下3*犀牛，3*犀牛，3*犀牛 你也可以上面的GDI/Alliance/Nod还是Plane1/2全都不写，不写就是所有阵营所有运输机通用同一套数据不做区分 Type=ParaDrop和Type=AmerParaDrop只有一些默认值的区别，AI都会使用。

长描述: 矿满的时候出现CSF提示 PipScale=Tiberium 储藏的矿石将以一个特定的PipScale表现出来。储藏矿石的建筑将通过格子显示当前有多少被占据的空间，并将其与该建筑的总格数进行直观对比。矿石将显示为黄色，彩色矿石则是蓝色。 若要将该逻辑用于带有Refinery=yes或ResourceDestination=yes的建筑上，你还需要添加Refinery.UseStorage=yes。这个条件之所以被添加，是因为如果没有的话，游戏会自动让所有未被修改过的矿石精炼厂都带有相应的PipScale。 流程 1.游戏规定一个玩家所持有现金的最大数额Cmax，玩家的游戏开局资金不计入其中。设每一座储藏井的储藏量为C0。 2.玩家建设一座启用储藏逻辑的精炼厂。 3.采矿车采矿完毕，到精炼厂进行精炼。设精炼开始前玩家现金数额为C，采矿车所提供的矿石价值为C1。 4.若C+C1＞Cmax，且玩家有多余的储藏空间，则玩家在精炼完成时的现金数额将达到Cmax，同时游戏自动将矿石按照比例储藏于精炼厂内；若无多余储藏空间，则发出提示EVA_SilosNeeded。（相当于你的额外部分矿石作废） 5.若C+C1≤Cmax，则玩家在精炼完成时的现金数额将达到C+C1，此时储藏空间将不会发生变化。 6.当玩家已建设n座精炼厂/储藏井时，其当前所持现金的最大数额将增长到Cmax+n*C0。
英文注释: Set this to a text that shall be printed whenever the Silos Needed warning occurs. You cannot unset this later. If you want to disable this message in a game mode or map, you will have to a label of an empty text. Defaults to no message.

长描述: 一个随机数从0到该语句设置的值将加到钱箱给定的基本数值，设置0将不会产生随机数，永远是钱箱给定的数值。默认900

长描述: 全局开火速度倍数，越小越快。默认0.5，即开火速度快两倍

长描述: 当 AI 的单位被 EMP，等 EMP 解除后执行的任务。默认 Hunt。

长描述: 非友方看该建筑时显示这个名称，而不是真实名称。 从 Phobos Build#27 版本开始已经支持全 TechnoType 使用

英文注释: The veterancy bonus to grant to any AircraftType or any ConsideredAircraft=yes VehicleType if a player owns one of these buildings. Defaults to 0.0.

长描述: 拥有这样的建筑后新生产的载具得到多少经验
英文注释: The veterancy bonus to grant to any VehicleType with Organic=no and ConsideredAircraft=no if a player owns one of these buildings. Defaults to 0.0.

长描述: 拥有这样的建筑后新生产的建筑得到多少经验 以下语句可以用来指定部分单位得到训练所的影响，不写的话就是默认 none，效果为全部可受影响
英文注释: The veterancy bonus to grant to any BuildingType if a player owns one of these buildings. Defaults to 0.0.

长描述: 损伤持续到多少停止。默认[General]►Degrade.Percentage

长描述: 建筑物的拔起所需时间。默认[General]►BuildupTime. 注意：建筑物仍会在被放置下来的一瞬间就可以工作，而不是完全建成之后。

长描述: 决定此建筑是否可以递光。 PrismForwarding= forward 代表此建筑可以为其他建筑递光，但自身不能接受递光。 PrismForwarding= attack 代表此建筑可以接受递光，但自身不能为其他建筑递光。 PrismForwarding= yes 代表此建筑具备完整的递光功能 - 既可以递光也可以接受递光。 PrismForwarding= no 代表此建筑不启动递光逻辑。 [General]►PrismType=的建筑默认yes，其他建筑默认no。
英文注释: Specifies whether or not this building is a Prism Tower. PrismForwarding=forward means that this building can support other towers but cannot attack as a Prism Tower. PrismForwarding=attack means that this building can attack as a Prism Tower but cannot support other towers. PrismForwarding=yes means that this building is a fully fledged Prism Tower - it can support other towers or attack. PrismForwarding=no means that this building is not a Prism Tower and will not be included in any prism networks. Defaults to yes for the building specified by [General]►PrismType, defaults to no for all other buildings.

长描述: 最大支援数量，-1表示无限制，默认[General]►PrismSupportMax=的值
英文注释: The maximum number of slave (support) towers that can feed directly into this one (i.e. adjacent towers). -1 means no limit. Defaults to [General]►PrismSupportMax.

长描述: 反向连接数量，-1表示无限制，默认1，如果要达到上图效果就要设置3
英文注释: The maximum number of backward links that can precede this tower. -1 means no limit. Default is 1. In order to achieve what is shown in the pre-release screenshot above, you would need to set this to at least 3.

长描述: 如果开火中的塔超过支援的塔，这个标签表示在递光网络的总数，不包括开火中的塔，默认[General]►PrismSupportMax=的值
英文注释: If this is the firing tower then PrismForwarding.MaxNetworkSize is the total number of towers allowed in the prism network, not including the firing tower itself. Only the firing tower dictates the maximum network size, regardless of what other tower types may be included in the network. -1 means no limit. Defaults to [General]►PrismSupportMax.

长描述: 递光杀伤倍数，默认[General]►PrismSupportModifier=的值
英文注释: This works in the same way as the old PrismSupportModifier - it is the amount of multiplier that this tower will contribute to the firing beam. The multiplier accumulates in a linear fashion (i.e. if there are 2 support towers, each with PrismForwarding.SupportModifier=150%, then the total multiplier to damage will be 150% + 150% + 100% = 400%. Defaults to [General]►PrismSupportModifier.

长描述: 增加固定的伤害而不是倍数，默认0
英文注释: A flat damage bonus added to the firing beam before the PrismForwarding.SupportModifier multiplier is applied. This can be used instead of the multiplier, or it can be used in conjunction with the multiplier to progressively dial up or down the final damage as more towers are included in the network. Defaults to 0. Note You will need to limit the number of towers in the network if dialing down the damage bonus, otherwise the firing beam may end up becoming a healing weapon. You can input your own values into the Prism Forwarding spreadsheet to see the effect this has on the damage dealt by your prism networks.

长描述: 递光高度，默认[General]►PrismSupportHeight=的值 （3.0已废除此标签，3.0前也实际无效）
递光时充能的延迟，默认1，最好别动（作者如是说，这玩意儿是用来测试玩的）
随着递光增加激光的宽度 递光与副武器的关联已经解除！
英文注释: This allows you to control how thick the laser beam grows as the size of the prism network increases. By default, a firing Prism Tower that is supported by 1 or more other towers would have a LaserThickness of 5 - that’s 2 higher than the default LaserThickness of the firing weapon (3). The PrismForwarding.Intensity flag treats negative values as an absolute addition to the firing beam, so the default value of -2 leaves the behavior exactly the same as the original game. Positive values, on the other hand, tell Ares that you want the thickness of the beam to be dependent on the number of backward chains in the network, and also have the support beam thickness increase in the same way. A PrismForwarding.Intensity value of 1 would cause the farthest beam to have no thickness increase, the next to have an increase of 1, the next to have an increase of 2, and so on. See the section on LaserThickness for more information regarding the way lasers are drawn.

长描述: 建筑的阻挡高度，默认为0，即可以完全穿透，-1意味着可以完全阻挡，单位为格，一格等于256像素 注意：不建议用在不是矩形或者镂空的建筑上，例如巴黎铁塔这种越往上越尖的建筑，因为炮弹打上去可能表现得像是在半空爆炸
英文注释: How tall the solid part of the building is considered to be, measured in cells (each cell has a height of 256 leptons), so buildings with a large amount of clear space near their top can allow projectiles to fly through that space. Negative values (e.g. -1) tell the game to consider the building’s full Height as solid. Default is 0, meaning the building is not at all solid (as per the normal game). Note The solid building logic does not lend itself well to non-rectangular buildings, such as the Paris Tower or Space Needle.

长描述: 建筑的坚固程度，默认1 全局设定 可以设定是否友军抛射体能够直接透过建筑攻击目标，映射 AlliedWallTransparency
英文注释: The solidity of this building. Defaults to 1.

长描述: 被渗透后使建筑所属方停电多长时间，单位：帧 钱
英文注释: The number of frames for which the enemy’s power will be sabotaged (i.e. temporarily reduced to zero).

长描述: 固定偷多少钱
英文注释: NEW EFFECT The fixed amount of credits that will be stolen from the enemy upon spying this enemy building. Defaults to 0. If used together with SpyEffect.StolenMoneyPercentage, this defines the maximum amount of money to steal. Quickstart If you want to express “Take three quarters of the enemy’s money, but no more than 10,000 credits”, use both tags: SpyEffect.StolenMoneyPercentage=75% and SpyEffect.StolenMoneyAmount=10000.

长描述: 偷钱百分比 两者同时定义时，效果为偷取百分之多少的钱，最多不超过多少。比如75%，10000，那么将偷取敌方75%当前资金，但最多只能偷到10000钱 超级武器
英文注释: The percentage of the enemy’s current credits that will be stolen from the enemy upon spying this enemy building. Defaults to 0%.

长描述: 这个建筑的偷窃项（0-31），可以填一个列表，一次提供多个
英文注释: The stealable technology types that is stolen upon spying this enemy building. Only values from 0 to 31 (inclusive) are supported. Use -1 to disable the effect. Defaults to -1. Note Note that despite its singular name this tag takes a list of integers and it is thus possible to steal several technology types when infiltrating a single building.

长描述: 设置当该建筑被渗透时，过指定帧数后爆炸（就像被安了C4一样）。如果设定负值，则读取[CombatDamage]►C4Delay=的值，设定0将取消这个功能。默认0。
英文注释: The number of frames after which the building will be demolished as if C4 had been planted. If negative, [CombatDamage]►C4Delay is used. Use 0 to disable. Defaults to 0.

长描述: AI将在不同难度下建造几个这种建筑，依次为困难，中等，简单。设定数值必须大于等于1。默认1,1,1
英文注释: The number of buildings the AI will build of this type depending on the difficulty. Order is hard to easy. Each value must be equal to or greater than 1. Defaults to 1,1,1.

长描述: AI将在不同难度下额外建造几个这种建筑，依次为困难，中等，简单。AI将会在随机建造完之后，额外建造建筑物。设定数值必须大于等于0，默认0,0,0 决定一个建筑是否可以为AI提供拓展
英文注释: The maximum number of extra buildings the AI can build of this type depending on the difficulty. Order is hard to easy. A random number of buildings will be build in addition to the ones from the normal build count. Each value must be equal to or greater than 0. Defaults to 0,0,0.

长描述: 有多少几率攻击能够穿透这个掩体直接攻击到里面的步兵（同时也因此不会对建筑造成杀伤），默认0
英文注释: The percentage of shots that will pass through to the occupants (and therefore not damage this building). Defaults to 0% (i.e. all shots damage the building / no shots damage the occupants). When there are no occupants inside then UC.PassThrough will be ignored (i.e. all shots damage the building).

长描述: 如武器能够穿透，那么瞬间击杀一名驻军的几率（无视武器杀伤等设置），默认0
英文注释: In the event that a shot has passed through, the percentage of those shots that will instantly kill one occupant, disregarding the weapon entirely. Defaults to 0%.

长描述: 如果武器能够穿透，在非一击必杀时对一名驻军步兵的杀伤倍率，默认 100% 即沿用武器自身原值
英文注释: If a shot has passed through but isn’t necessarily fatal then one occupant will be damaged. The damage dealt by the weapon will be multiplied by UC.DamageMultiplier. Defaults to 100% (i.e. no change to the damage dealt by the weapon).

长描述: 被摧毁时废墟建筑给谁。默认default即给原来的所有者
英文注释: The country the destroyed building will belong to. default is the current owner, civilian is the first country from the side called Civilian, special and neutral are the countries named Special and Neutral respectively. Defaults to default.

长描述: 变成废墟建筑时的血量 正值里，有效值到最大到Strength 负值里，有效值从-99至-1代表相对Strength的百分比，例如-1意味着剩1%的血量 剩余的值全都意味着满血 默认和Strength相同
英文注释: The health the rubble building is created with. Positive values up to Strength are used directly. Negative values down to -99 are a percentage of full health, -1 meaning 1% of health. All other values mean full health. Defaults to Strength.

长描述: 被修复后的建筑给谁，与Destroyed规则一致
英文注释: The country the recovered building will belong to. default is the current owner, civilian is the first country from the side called Civilian, special and neutral are the countries named Special and Neutral respectively. Defaults to default.

长描述: 被修复时建筑的血量。与Destroyed规则一致 默认-1，1%的血量
英文注释: The health the recovered building is created with. Positive values up to Strength are used directly. Negative values down to -99 are a percentage of full health, -1 meaning 1% of health. All other values mean full health. Defaults to -1, 1% of Strength.

长描述: 指定这个战壕的名称，只有同种战壕能够穿越，拥有相同名称的战壕会像围墙那样根据GuardRange自动连接，也用于像围墙那样造光棱塔等玩法 注意：战壕不支持在水和沙滩上链接，与激光墙不同
英文注释: Specifies a unique name for this particular trench so that the game knows that it is a trench for traversal purposes, and allows occupants to transfer between segments of the same trench type.

长描述: 填百分比，该建筑被罩护盾后的实际受影响时间将会是力场护盾本身的时间乘以这个值，如果填0那么该建筑无法得到护盾，默认100％ 铁幕的见 铁幕弹头 一节
英文注释: The number of seconds of Force Shield duration is multiplied by this value. Valid values are 0% (Force Shield disallowed) or higher. Defaults to 100%. Note Buildings with a ForceShield.Modifier value of 0.0 or less are not eligible to fire a Force Shield super weapon on.

长描述: 伤害量，默认电力充足时和[General]►Degrade.AmountNormal一样，其他情况[General]►Degrade.AmountConsumer 国家设置
英文注释: The amount of damage this building will receive each interval of DamageDelay in low power situations. A value of 0 will not degrade this building. Defaults to [General]►Degrade.AmountNormal if Power is greater than or equal to 0, otherwise to [General]►Degrade.AmountConsumer.

长描述: 占领时显示CSF。需要NeedsEngineer=yes。默认none
英文注释: The text printed when a building of this type is captured by the player. Requires NeedsEngineer=yes. Defaults to none.

长描述: 丢失时显示CSF。需要NeedsEngineer=yes。默认none
英文注释: The text printed when a building of this type is captured by the enemy. Requires NeedsEngineer=yes. Defaults to none.

长描述: 矿厂的哪一格用来卸矿，这一格必须可通行，默认3,1
英文注释: The cell a harvester will dock on when unloading on this refinery. The cell is required to be passable. Defaults to 3,1.

长描述: 卸矿时矿车朝向哪一面，从正北（屏幕右上）开始32分圆，默认8（正东，屏幕右下） 矿车 一个矿车采完一格矿后使用Short的范围寻找下一格矿 一个矿车矿场倒完矿或从停止状态开始寻矿时使用Long的范围寻找接下来要采的矿来找到矿区，使用TooFar的范围来决定多远以外的矿不进行考虑
英文注释: The facing a harvester will turn to when docking on this refinery. Defaults to 8 (east).

长描述: 被EMP的单位的变黑程度。默认0.8
英文注释: The light level for voxel units under EMP. See EMP logic. Defaults to 0.8.

长描述: 需要驾驶员的载具无驾驶员时的变黑程度。默认0.65
英文注释: The light level for unoperated voxel units. See Operator logic. Defaults to 0.65.

长描述: 失去控制的单位的变黑程度。默认0.5 注意 这个值一般取0到1之间，写1就是和原来亮度一样，如果超过1那么会变亮 SHP类的单位是不会被这个影响的。
英文注释: The light level for unpowered voxel units. See PoweredBy logic. Defaults to 0.5.

长描述: 在相邻两次反隐形通报中间隔几分钟。
英文注释: Minutes between EVA repeating the warning that a stealth unit has been detected. Defaults to 0.0.

长描述: 在相邻两次反钻地通报中间隔几分钟。 抑制反隐传感器的警告

长描述: 升级到老兵时闪光多长时间。默认0 音效，EVA和闪光
英文注释: The number of frames a newly veteran unit or structure will flash for. Defaults to 0.

长描述: 如果要在不同地表用不同的色盘，请使用~~~作为代表气候类型，例如： CustomPalette=abcd.pal一直使用abcd.pal CustomPalette=lib~~~.pal使用libtem.pal, libsno.pal, etc. 注意 动画抛射体所调用的动画需要在 [Animations] 注册表中注册 （来自Ares官方的温馨提示，不过这也不是 CustomPalette 自身引入的问题，工作方式本就如此） （当然你也可以给那些多面的单帧非动画抛射体注册进动画注册表来让它们可以使用自定义色盘） 对于单位和建筑体的自定义色盘请使用Palette=xxx 对应使用 xxxtem.pal、xxxsno.pal、xxxurb.pal、xxxdes.pal、xxxlun.pal、xxxubn.pal 六个色盘，记得不要漏 建筑动画的色盘默认与建筑体色盘相同 若要独立定义，需要给建筑动画加ShouldUseCellDrawer=false然后用CustomPalette指定 *CustomPalette不支持所属色，因此要么不用要么分离所属色部分 （反正你所属色本就只看色号随后根据所属方重新映射颜色也无所谓所谓动画自定义颜色的问题） 由于原版FinalAlert2绘制建筑时的Shape资源文件读取机制是先把多个Shape文件合成后再调用色盘因此无法在FinalAlert2中正确绘制使用了CustomPalette的建筑动画 粒子的色盘不使用这个，并且在RULES中定义，详见粒子系统 一节
英文注释: Specifies the palette used to draw this animation/projectile.

长描述: 动画武器造成伤害的间隔。默认0。对原版动画弹头造成杀伤也适用
距离动画中心产生粒子的最小距离。默认0.0 如果写负值则使用其绝对值，这使得粒子产生位置有两倍几率更接近动画中心。
英文注释: The distance from the center where particles start spawning at. Defaults to 0.0. Note If negative, the resulting random distance could come out as negative. If this happens, the absolute value is used. This allows doubling the chance to spawn particles closer to the center.

Defaults to no if providing one or more of the following special functions: Radar Super weapons (SuperWeapon and SuperWeapon2 only) Undeploy into a vehicle (e.g. Construction Yards) Powers vehicles (e.g. Robot Control Centre) Gap Generator Sensors Laser Fence Posts Defaults to yes otherwise. InfantryTypes: Defaults to no if Cyborg=yes, to yes otherwise. VehicleTypes and AircraftTypes: Defaults to yes if Organic=yes, to no otherwise.

长描述: 该载具是否允许被偷窃，默认为是 提示： 默认情况下劫车犯不能劫持中立车辆，包括被 击杀驾驶员 的，但是你可以通过连用 VehicleThief=yes 和 CanDrive=yes 来允许。 新增逻辑 全局功能
英文注释: Whether this VehicleType or AircraftType can be hijacked by vehicle thieves. Defaults to yes.

长描述: 是否在Guard模式（放在那不管）下能够主动攻击，如果设置no，那么这个单位不会主动攻击，不过在Area Guard模式下依然可以主动攻击。默认yes
英文注释: Whether this unit can acquire targets on their own when in guard mode. If set to no, the unit will hold fire, but can be made to acquire own targets by putting it in area guard mode. Defaults to yes.

长描述: 是否在隐形且处于Guard模式下能够主动攻击，如果设置no，那么这个单位在隐形时不会主动攻击，不过在Area Guard模式下依然可以主动攻击。CanPassiveAquire.Guard=no会覆盖这个标签，默认yes 如果第一条yes（默认），第二条no，那隐形坦克在隐形状态就不会主动攻击，但是暴露时就会主动攻击，或者一些平时不会隐形的单位，也可以设置这条，当偶然获得隐形时就不会随便惹事了。 注意：由于 OpportunityFire=yes 等原因记录了目标那么由于目标没有丢失仍会继续开火。
英文注释: Whether this unit can acquire targets on their own when the unit is cloakable and in guard mode. If set to no, the unit will hold fire if cloakable and in guard mode, but can be made to acquire own targets by putting it in area guard mode. CanPassiveAquire.Guard=no overrides this tag. Defaults to yes.

长描述: 是否不能手动选择目标进行攻击，仅依靠单位自身判断进行攻击。默认no 禁止手动卸载乘员 这可以让玩家不能手动逐出乘员，可以用到超空间监狱上面去。当然，被摧毁的时候依然会出来，如果要改成被摧毁时不出来参考生还者逻辑。 [VehicleType/AircraftType]►NoManualUnload= (boolean) 是否不能手动卸载乘员。默认no 3.0RC5开始已经不影响从坦克碉堡撤出了 禁止手动装载乘员
英文注释: Whether players may not select targets for this type of object manually. If enabled, units will have to rely on auto-targeting and retaliation rules. Defaults to no.

长描述: 是否不能手动装载乘员。默认no 禁止手动区域防御 如果你把鼠标放到军医上就会显示区域防御指针，现在可以取消这种情况。
英文注释: Whether units will not get an enter or no-enter cursor when on this object. If yes, the select cursor is used, as if this unit is not a transport. Defaults to no.

长描述: 这个单位是否会在攻击时老是想着去压对方，即使它跑得比西方记者还慢，如果否，这个单位不会想法设法接近对方碾毙之。需要OmniCrusher=yes。默认yes
英文注释: Whether or not a unit should try to crush its target aggressively. If no, the unit will not try to come as close as possible to the target to finally crush it. Requires OmniCrusher=yes. Defaults to yes. Note Only supported if OmniCrusher=yes is set. The default might change in a later version.

长描述: 当盖特计数器到达最后一阶盖特的 StageX 值后是否会跳回第一阶，默认no即原版行为
英文注释: When the last Stage or EliteStage is completed, the counter will wrap around and restart with the first stage without the firing unit losing target. Requires IsGattling=yes. Defaults to no.

长描述: 是否可以隐形，如果写否那么就算用隐形装置也不能让这玩意儿隐形，默认yes 反隐形 在TS里SensorArray=yes使用SensorsSight=的范围来探知隐形和地下单位,并且绘制范围扫描圈。 即使被摧毁然而探知能力仍然存在的问题将不再发生。 两个新的EVA警告已经被添加，EVA_CloakedUnitDetected和EVA_SubterraneanUnitDetected，这两个会在探测到隐形单位或地下单位时播放。 设置反隐形或反地下单位的通报间隔
英文注释: Whether this techno is allowed to cloak at all. If set to no, this techno is not allowed to be cloaked (neither through self-cloak nor through Cloak Generators). Defaults to yes.

长描述: 单位被传感器侦测到是否会发出警告。默认yes
英文注释: Whether EVA warnings and radar events should be generated if this type is detected. This does not hide the unit or building from the Sensor Array, and the object will still become visible. Defaults to yes.

长描述: 载具里的乘客开火载具能够得到经验，默认yes
英文注释: Allow OpenTopped=yes and Gunner=yes units to gain experience when a passenger kills an enemy. If this is no the unit only gets promoted when killing enemies itself. For gunners like the IFV this means the vehicle may not have any passengers to gain experience. Defaults to yes.

长描述: 如果载具满级那么乘客得到经验，默认no
英文注释: If an OpenTopped=yes or Gunner=yes unit is trainable and already elite, the passenger shooting will get the experience instead. If this is no the additional experience will be lost as the vehicle is elite already. Defaults to no.

长描述: 如果一个击杀由鲍里斯那样的召唤飞机做的, 召唤者能够得到经验而不是给飞机，默认no
英文注释: If a kill gets credited to an aircraft that was called in by an air strike, the designator will get the experience instead of the actual aircraft. Defaults to no.

长描述: 是否所有有Trainable=yes的单位会被设置为与该载具相同的等级。默认no
英文注释: Whether all Trainable=yes passengers will be set to the same rank if the rank of this transport unit changes. Defaults to no. Note The passengers’ veterancy is discarded when the vehicle is promoted. This should not be used on manually controllable transports, because they could degrade elite passengers to veterans, for example.

长描述: 决定这个单位能否让玩家保持存活，这是从DontScore=和Insignificant=中分离出来的逻辑。只要玩家持有至少一个可以这样的单位，便不会因为快速游戏而被判负。 对于Insignificant=no和DontScore=no的建筑默认为yes，其他默认为no。 列在 [General]►BaseUnit= 中的载具始终拥有等效于 KeepAlive=yes 的效果。
英文注释: Whether an object of this type will keep the owning player alive, independent of DontScore= and Insignificant=. Defaults to yes for Insignificant=no and DontScore=no buildings, to no otherwise (including all units, infantry and aircraft). Note No matter this setting, VehicleTypes contained in the [General]►BaseUnit= list will always keep the player alive during Short Games. This might change in the future.

长描述: 决定此单位能否在有UnitSell=yes的Dock建筑内进行变卖。默认[General]►UnitsUnsellable=
英文注释: Whether this unit can be sold at UnitSell=yes docking structures. Defaults to [General]►UnitsUnsellable=.

长描述: 例如，给单位设置Image=JUNK和AlternateTheaterArt=yes会使这个单位使用雪地装 [JUNKA]，沙漠装 [JUNKD] 等等，没有相应SHP默认 [JUNK]，比原来的更灵活 最后一个字母的规则与NewTheater相同，T代表温和，A代表雪地，U代表城市，D代表沙漠，L代表月球，N代表新城市
英文注释: Specifies whether or not this SHP-based unit can have alternate art depending on the theater of the current map. For example, setting Image=JUNK and AlternateTheaterArt=yes on a unit will make the unit load artmd.ini section [JUNKA] on arctic, [JUNKD] on desert, and so on according to theater. If any of those sections do not exist then the unit will fall back to [JUNK]. So quite similar to AlternateArcticArt, just automatic and smarter. Defaults to no.

长描述: 这个单位能否把等级给敌人看，默认[General]►EnemyInsignia 注意 观察者还是看得到的。
英文注释: Whether insignia for a unit of this type will be shown for enemy players. Defaults to [General]►EnemyInsignia.

长描述: 决定一个单位是否免疫狂暴，即神经突击车的攻击效果。可以覆盖ImmuneToPsionics和psionicsimmune升级能力的效果。如果yes，即使ImmuneToPsionics=no也能免疫狂暴；如果no，单位一定能被混乱气体影响。默认ImmuneToPsionics或psionicsimmune升级能力（也就是说默认行为是动态的） 对于升级获取免疫效果见 精英和老兵时获得的能力 一节，对于新增免疫类型见 新增免疫类型 一节
英文注释: Whether this object is immune to berserking, the Chaos Gas effect. Can be used to override ImmuneToPsionics and the PSIONICSIMMUNE ability. If set to yes, the object is not affected by Chaos Gas even if not ImmuneToPsionics=yes; if set to no, the object can be affected by Chaos Gas despite maybe being immune to psionics. If not set, acts as if set to yes if ImmuneToPsionics=yes or the object gained the PSIONICSIMMUNE ability through veterancy, otherwise as if set to no. Note Currently, the default of not being set cannot be restored once this tag has been set.

长描述: 这种单位是否被视为主动攻击目标。默认no 如果平民单位不被视作威胁，那么只有当这些平民单位攻击你的单位时才会进行反击，典型如器官兽和泰伯利亚肉球把房子一个个拆掉。这里有两个新的全局标签改善这种情况。
英文注释: Whether this unit is considered an enemy when auto-acquiring a target. Enabling this prevents a unit of this type to be considered neutral in multiplayer matches. Defaults to no.

长描述: 该单位是否拥有获得赏金的能力。默认no
英文注释: Whether this object will be awarded bounty when destroying enemy units or structures either by firing at them or by crushing them. Defaults to no.

长描述: 是否摧毁单位获得赏金时显示获得效果。默认[AudioVisual]►BountyDisplay 微观（定义猎物）
英文注释: Whether enemy units and structures will display the amount of bounty awarded when destroyed by an object of this type. Defaults to [AudioVisual]►BountyDisplay.

长描述: 定义该单位是否会飙出 DamageParticleSystems 所指定的粒子系统。对于步兵默认同 Cyborg=的值，其他默认 no。
英文注释: Defines whether an object of this type should spawn spark particle systems defined by DamageParticleSystems. Defaults to Cyborg for InfantryTypes, to no otherwise.

长描述: 这个单位不能被吸入只会受到伤害，默认no
英文注释: Specifies whether the unit cannot be abducted. Only the conventional damage is dealt. Defaults to no.

长描述: 吸单位后会改变炮塔，吸入一个改变一次 0 passengers footur.vxl 1 passenger footur1.vxl 5 passengers footur5.vxl 要用这个逻辑该单位必须使用Turret=yes，TurretCount，WeaponX
英文注释: If set to yes, this unit’s turret will switch to the turret with the index equivalent to the number of passengers it holds. Defaults to no. 0 passengers footur.vxl 1 passenger footur1.vxl 5 passengers footur5.vxl Note In order to use this, you have to use YR’s multi-turret logic, that is, you have to specify Turret=yes, an appropriate TurretCount, and you have to use the WeaponX flags to specify weapons.

长描述: 吸取单位或被吸的建筑中至少一者为yes则吸取时仅吸取该建筑的电力而非连带整个基地的电力，默认no
英文注释: Whether this unit drains only the local power from its target building, or whether this building does not bring down the entire power grid of the owning player when drained. If any of the draining unit or the building drained have this set to yes, only the local power is drained. If both have this set to no, then the victim’s entire power is drained. Defaults to no.

长描述: 该载具驾驶员能否被杀死。默认yes
英文注释: Whether the driver of this vehicle cannot be killed, i.e. whether this vehicle is immune to KillDriver. Organic=yes and Natural=yes units are always immune to KillDriver. Defaults to no.

长描述: 该步兵能否占领驾驶被狙杀驾驶员的中立载具。默认不能 如果载具需要 Operator 那么步兵驾驶员会启动载具并作为乘客进入，随后可以退出，否则驾驶员会被移除，然后组一辈子的车队
英文注释: Whether this InfantryType can act as the driver of vehicles whose driver has been killed, effectively reclaiming the vehicle. If the vehicle requires an Operator the infantry driver turns the unit and enters as passenger that can be ejected later, otherwise the driver is swallowed, becoming the permanent driver of the vehicle. Defaults to no.

长描述: 决定这个单位能否被 CanDrive=yes 的步兵占领。即便可以也可能由于所属方等问题无法被占领。
英文注释: Whether this unit can be reclaimed by a driver. If no, this unit cannot be captured by a driver after the original driver has been killed. If yes, ownership and other still might still prevent the unit from being captured. Defaults to yes.

长描述: 这个单位被摧毁时是否会洒出自己所携带的矿石。默认no 矿石关联单位当前携带的类型和数量，如果单位当前空仓（及不能运输矿石）则不会洒，毕竟没得洒 如果希望不检查这些，只要摧毁就产生矿石，参见 泰伯利亚残留。
英文注释: Whether this techno with positive Storage will spill parts of its stored tiberium when destroyed. Defaults to no.

长描述: 有这条语句的单位可以被治疗。默认no。 以下参数可以用于调整泰伯利亚矿的治愈值
英文注释: Whether this unit heals if standing on a cell containing Tiberium. Defaults to no. Note If yes, units leave behind a random amount of tiberium when destroyed or killed by default. This can be customized. See Tiberium Remains.

长描述: 该单位被摧毁时是否留下泰伯利亚，默认TiberiumHeal当[General]►TiberiumHealEnabled=yes开启时，否则不
英文注释: Whether this unit leaves behind tiberium when destroyed. Defaults to TiberiumHeal if [General]►TiberiumHealEnabled=yes, to no otherwise.

长描述: 是否免疫泰矿伤害。步兵默认no，其他类型单位是 泰矿伤害和弹头
指定这个单位能否被空间转移超武转移，默认yes 如果 SW.AffectsTarget 有 buildings 那么这句即可决定建筑能否被超时空传送 否则需要让建筑被视为载具来使用传送，即下句和 空间传送 页相关内容
英文注释: Specifies whether this unit is allowed to be affected by the Chronosphere super weapon. Otherwise it will be ignored. Defaults to yes.

长描述: 如果设置为no，那么这个单位不会被超时空传送过来的单位压在下面，取而代之的是被超时空传送过来的单位被摧毁（下克上）。不要用在建筑上。默认yes
英文注释: If set to no, this unit can no longer be crushed by chronoshifting units onto it. Instead, the chronoshifting unit will be destroyed. Does not apply to BuildingTypes. Defaults to yes.

长描述: 是否狩猎者不把这个单位作为攻击目标，即使没有其他目标了狩猎者也不会对其进行攻击。默认no
是否建立雷达事件，超时空超武两个点都会创建。然而这东西疑似没做完而且许多超武类型都在Ares中硬编码禁用了它。
是否在防御栏显示此超武，默认yes 这个语句 需要SW.AutoFire=yes 才有效 也就是只有SW.AutoFire=yes时才能用SW.ShowCameo=no来隐藏图标 可以额外添加SW.AITargeting=None来禁用SW.AutoFire=yes的效果 你可以为了另外两条的工作而给它把 AITargeting 设置成 None
决定这个超武是否刚获得时就充能完毕，当发射一次之后，计时恢复正常。默认no
决定这个超武使用虚拟充能 这个逻辑可以用来分开超武充能和建筑存在。若开启则即便失去超武建筑，计时器也会隐藏到后台继续充能，等到所属方再次持有建筑时重新显示图标和计时器。默认no
能否丢进黑幕，默认yes
英文注释: Whether or not this super weapon is allowed to fire into an unexplored area of the map. Default is yes.

长描述: 如果是，则人类玩家点击图标时自动发射超武，而不需要手动选择目标。选择目标交给AITargeting。 如果不符合AI瞄准的约束条件，则超武图标会黑掉（约束条件见下），如果超武目前无法依靠AITargeting发射，会反馈一个文本信息给玩家。
英文注释: Whether AI targeting will decide the target used when firing this super weapon. If yes, clicking the cameo will not allow manual target selection and instead fire the super weapon at an automatically determined location. Defaults to no. All applicable AI targeting constraints have to be satisfied for the super weapon to fire and actually discharge. If the constraints are not satisfied, the cameo will be darkened. If the player tries to fire the super weapon anyhow, the message Message.CannotFire is displayed.

长描述: 无需点击自动发出，会根据AITargeting的值进行评估，默认no 仅在本语句启用时SW.ShowCameo和SW.ManualFire才生效
英文注释: Sets whether this super weapon will be launched automatically once ready even for human players. If set to yes, the AI targeting options are used to infer the target cell. Defaults to no.

长描述: 能否人工发出，即SW.AutoFire没有目标时玩家能否自己指定目标，若no掉则玩家点击图标后不会获得光标
英文注释: Sets whether this super weapon can be manually fired by the owning player. If set to no, the player will not be able to get a selection cursor for this super weapon when clicking the cameo. This setting is ignored if SW.AutoFire=no is set, because the player would have no way to fire this super weapon. Defaults to yes. Note You can use this on auto-firing super weapons where the targeting mode might prevent it from being fired (like the Lightning Storm or Psychic Dominator, if another super weapon of this type is currently active).

长描述: 是否任何单位都能做指示者，覆盖SW.Designators。默认no
英文注释: Whether any unit or structure is considered a valid designator for this super weapon. Overrides SW.Designators. Defaults to no.

长描述: 是否任何单位都能做抑制者，覆盖上面那个。
英文注释: Whether any unit or structure is considered a valid inhibitor for this super weapon. Overrides SW.Inhibitors. Defaults to no.

长描述: 决定这个超武是否为玩家所有，默认yes
英文注释: Whether this super weapon will be available to human players. Defaults to yes.

长描述: 决定这个超武是否为AI所有，默认yes 辅助建筑 在TS里NOD有一个叫化学飞弹的超武，这个超武必须要有另一个非超武建筑化学工厂（介绍是化学工厂生产化学飞弹）才能使用，化学工厂被称为辅助建筑，这个逻辑在ARES里得到了复原。
英文注释: Whether this super weapon will be available to AI players. Defaults to yes.

长描述: 决定此超武是否不需要建筑，直接出现。仍然遵循AuxBuilding, SW.AuxBuidings, SW.NegBuildings, SW.ForbiddenHouses, SW.RequiredHouses, SW.AllowPlayer和SW.AllowAI。默认no 注意：这个语句会影响一些超武的表现形式 例如没有核弹井时就拥有核弹，那么核弹会表现为Nuke.SiloLaunch=no时的效果 当同时拥有核弹井时才会重新变为从核弹井中发射，所以也曾用于做根据建筑的超武效果切换效果 新增鼠标 具体可以看自定义鼠标动作
英文注释: Whether this super weapon is not provided by any particular building but is instead always available as long as the player has not been defeated. Defaults to no.

长描述: 是否禁止手工停止，注意这个功能简直就是 火风暴 和 电池 专用，用于别的超武未必合适。 花费
英文注释: Whether this super weapon can be stopped when active. Otherwise clicks on the super weapon’s cameo are ignored. Defaults to no.

长描述: 是否用玩家色显示信息，默认no
英文注释: Messages are displayed in the firing house’s color scheme. Defaults to no.

长描述: 是否引起全局光改变，只支持第一超武 第一超武就是指核弹、闪电风暴、心灵支配三类，其他类型的超武想改变全局光效就要同步释放一个可以改变全局光效的超武 由于这三种中只有核弹超武可以全场多个位置同时无CD释放，所以它是最优选项。例如你用其他超武做了一个假的闪电风暴超武又需要改变全局光，那么你就可以持续引爆一个核弹超武来改变光照。同步释放的方法包括但不限于一开始丢一个建筑挂上瞄准方式为自身的真超武和专用于改变全局光的超武用完把建筑炸了、现代拓展引擎的超武Next、超武释放时引爆一个武器使用弹头释放超武逻辑……
英文注释: Whether the lighting gets respected or not. Currently only the primary super weapons support lighting changes.

长描述: 是否会出现闪电风暴接近中的CSF。默认[General]►LightningPrintText 可以用前文 Message.* 部分的内容自由定义
英文注释: Enables the warning text appearing shortly before the Lightning Storm strikes. Defaults to [General]►LightningPrintText.

长描述: 是否无视建筑 避雷针 LightningRod=yes。默认no
英文注释: Disables the special handling for buildings with LightningRod=yes set. Defaults to no.

长描述: 是否从核弹井发射，否的话弹头会直接在目标点20000高度处落下，无法定义高度值 若为否则核弹发射建筑要有NukeSilo=yes 一些特殊情况 核弹的一切起飞武器之类都要用子武器列表注册，总之要照抄原来的那套，ARES允许多个类型核弹井发射同一超武。
英文注释: Whether this missile is launched from a building with NukeSilo=yes providing this super weapon. Otherwise the weapon defined by Nuke.Payload is created off-screen, aiming for the target cell. Defaults to yes.

长描述: 是否可以控制。默认可以
英文注释: Defines whether this Psychic Dominator captures units in its range. Otherwise only the damage is dealt. Defaults to yes.

长描述: 是否使用波纹效果
英文注释: Defines whether this Psychic Dominator creates a ripple effect when the Psychic Dominator strikes. Defaults to yes.

长描述: 是否可以控制已经被控制的单位。默认yes
英文注释: Defines whether this Psychic Dominator can capture units that are mind-controlled already. Otherwise already mind-controlled units are ignored. Defaults to yes.

长描述: 是否控制已经被其他心灵支配永久控制的单位。默认yes
英文注释: Defines whether this Psychic Dominator can capture units that are permanently mind-controlled already. Otherwise already permanently mind-controlled units are ignored. Defaults to yes.

长描述: 是否可以强行控制免疫心控的单位。默认no
英文注释: Defines whether this Psychic Dominator can capture units that usually aren’t mind-controllable. Setting this to yes ignores the ImmuneToPsionics tag on its victims. Defaults to no.

长描述: 是否永久。默认yes，不得再控制回去，如果否的话可以用普通的心灵控制武器把被受此心灵支配的单位控走
英文注释: Defines whether the victims are permanently mind-controlled. Setting this to no allows other mind-controllers to re-capture the victim, otherwise it will be uncapturable. Defaults to yes.

长描述: 是否移动 Chronoshift.IsVehicle=yes 的建筑。默认移动
英文注释: Defines whether the chronoshift will consider buildings with Chronoshift.IsVehicle=yes as vehicles instead. Otherwise deployed-vehicle type buildings always count as buildings like with the original Chronosphere. Defaults to yes.

长描述: 是否击杀 Organic=yes 的对象。默认yes，no 的话乌贼等生物类单位也可超时空 注：步兵默认 Organic=yes，即计算在内
英文注释: Defines whether the chronoshift will kill all organic units. Otherwise the units will not be killed by the chronoshift and teleport instead. Defaults to yes.

长描述: 在上一条为 yes 的情况下，是否即便这些单位有 Teleporter=yes 也依旧击杀。默认no
英文注释: Defines whether the chronoshift will kill units with Teleporter=yes set. Otherwise the units will be chronoshifted. Defaults to no.

长描述: 当单位被超时空时，击杀内部的乘员／驻兵。默认no
英文注释: Whether all passengers and occupants should be killed when the object is chronshifted. Defaults to no.

长描述: 是否可以移动铁幕单位。默认no
英文注释: Defines whether the chronoshift will affect iron curtained units. Otherwise the units will be ignored. Defaults to no.

长描述: 是否受Warpable=no影响。默认yes 这是Ares新增的规则，如果没有Ares那么Warpable并不能禁用超时空移动
英文注释: Defines whether the chronoshift will affect units with Warpable=no set. Otherwise the units will be ignored. Defaults to yes.

Defaults to no. Note “Undeployable” means buildings that can undeploy, rather than vehicles that cannot deploy.

长描述: 是否摧毁超时空失败的建筑。默认yes 现在可以直接移动一般建筑，其他规则同上。 这里还是有问题，超时空的机场不允许生产飞机，探照灯会留在原地。

英文注释: Whether other buildings can be built adjacent to buildings delivered using this super weapon. If yes, normal base space rules will apply. If set to no, delivered buildings will not provide base space to build adjacent to. Defaults to yes.

长描述: 是否所有敌方实体都有均等的概率作为狩猎者的目标，如果不是, 非民用目标会被有限考虑；如果没有首选目标， 那么仍会选择随机选取目标进行攻击。默认no 如何设置狩猎者和攻击目标请去阵营与国家看。 关于狩猎者 狩猎者在TS里是一种飞行类单位并且有HunterSeeker=yes的设置，它由狩猎者超武发出，具体的请去ModEnc查看。

长描述: 是否只要一门炮满足发射范围，其他炮是否满足发射范围也无所谓，只有在SW.MaxCount超过1时才会表现出来 与直接将炮作为指示者的区别是其他炮可以不满足射程等要求。默认no

英文注释: Whether the unit gains cloaking ability while the AttachEffect lasts. Defaults to no.

英文注释: Whether affected units will be forced to decloak when the AttachEffect gets applied (useful for non-damaging anim-based AttachEffects). Defaults to no.

长描述: 那么当这个单位从地图上消失，比如进入建筑或单位里，AE效果是否会消失 默认no
英文注释: Whether the AttachEffect will be removed when the affected unit is removed from the map (entering a building or another unit). Defaults to no.

英文注释: Whether the AttachEffect can attach to a unit or structure under the influence of an Iron Curtain or Force Shield. Defaults to no.

长描述: 这个抛射体是否会被建筑阻挡，默认为否

英文注释: Whether this projectile can run out of fuel. Defaults to no.

分裂出的子武器是否会向发射者本身攻击。默认yes
该弹体是否受制于 UC.PassThrough 控制的概率，默认yes 若为 no 且目标建筑的 UC.PassThrough 大于 0 则目标建筑被命中时始终视为 UC.PassThrough=100% 时的效果 该功能最初为战壕设计——例如掷弹兵可以轻松将手雷投入露天战壕因此必然能对驻军造成杀伤
英文注释: Whether or not this projectile will override the normal UC.PassThrough chance on targeted buildings. If the projectile has SubjectToTrenches=no set, and the target building has UC.PassThrough set greater than zero, then the building will be treated as if it had UC.PassThrough=100%, when hit by this projectile. If SubjectToTrenches=yes is set (default), then the normal UC.PassThrough chance will be used when the building is hit by this projectile.

长描述: 是否能偷窃被心灵支配的载具，当进入载具该载具会切断与控制者的联系，默认为是
英文注释: Whether the vehicle thief can hijack units that are mind-controlled. The link between the controller and the unit will be broken when the hijacker enters. Otherwise the hijacker cannot steal the unit. Defaults to yes.

长描述: 劫车犯是否只能偷一次车即相当于占领（载具摧毁后将无法逃出）
英文注释: Whether the vehicle thief will be consumed in the process of capturing a unit. Otherwise the hijacker will emerge when the captured unit is destroyed. In every case the hijacker will be reimbursed when the unit is grinded. Defaults to no.

长描述: 是否不能手动区域防御。默认no
英文注释: Whether infantry units with negative damage weapons get the guard area cursor on themselves. If no, the guard area cursor will not take precedence, allowing other cursors like the deploy cursor to be shown. Defaults to no.

长描述: 需要部署才能隐形，默认no 只有有电时隐形 Powered=yes的建筑在没电时也是隐形的，这种情况可以用这个修正
英文注释: Whether this infantry is only allowed to self-cloak when deployed. Requires Deployer=yes and Cloakable=yes. Defaults to no.

英文注释: Defaults to yes for [COW], otherwise to no.

英文注释: Whether the firing timing and deploy behavior is changed for this infantry unit as described above. Defaults to yes for [DESO], otherwise to no.

Not supported together with vehicle hijacking, CanDrive=yes, C4 (either C4=yes or granted through veterancy) and Occupier=yes logics. Defaults to no.

Requires Crawls=yes, otherwise the unit will not sit down on Tiberium, as well as NotHuman=yes to not show human death animations when killed. Defaults to no.

长描述: 是否允许手动切换电源，默认no，在游戏里默认没有这个功能的热键，需要自己在键位设置里找

长描述: 上一条全局规定。默认no

英文注释: Whether structures will by default return to the civilian side when a player is defeated or giving up. Defaults to no.

You will have to manually set GroupAs on the groups you want to keep.

英文注释: Whether insignia will be shown for enemy players by default. Each unit type can override this value. Defaults to yes.

长描述: 心灵探测器探测到敌方核弹时在落点创建的警告动画。默认PSIWARN
英文注释: The Animation played at the nuke target, detectable by Psychic Sensors. Defaults to PSIWARN.

长描述: 超武释放时播放的动画。默认[General]►DominatorFirstAnim，原版是尤里大头
英文注释: The Animation hovering above the target for some time before the Psychic Dominator strikes. Defaults to [General]►DominatorFirstAnim.

长描述: 实际生效时候的动画。默认 [General]►DominatorSecondAnim，原版是红色的那个波纹
英文注释: The Animation hovering above the target when the Psychic Dominator strikes. Defaults to [General]►DominatorSecondAnim.

长描述: 被控制的单位头上的圆圈。默认[CombatDamage]►PermaControlledAnimationType
英文注释: The Animation displayed above units being mind-controlled by the Dominator permanently. Defaults to [CombatDamage]►PermaControlledAnimationType.

长描述: 点下超武后在超时空传送原点播放的动画。默认[General]►ChronoPlacement
英文注释: The animation to display at the super weapon’s target cell.

长描述: 传送发动时在起始点播放的动画。默认[General]►ChronoBlast
英文注释: The Animation played above the source when the chronoshift is started. Defaults to [General]►ChronoBlast.

长描述: 传送发动时在目标点播放的动画。默认[General]►ChronoBlastDest
英文注释: The Animation played above the destination when the chronoshift is started. Defaults to [General]►ChronoBlastDest.

长描述: 释放超武时在目标点创建的动画。对于Type=ForceShield的情况默认为[General]►ForceShieldInvokeAnim，否则为[General]►IronCurtainInvokeAnim
英文注释: The animation to display at the super weapon’s target cell.

长描述: 释放超武时在目标点创建的动画。默认[General]►IonBlast
英文注释: The animation to display at the super weapon’s target cell.

长描述: 发射武器前在炮口FLH位置表现的准备动画，写none可以禁用。默认PULSBALL
英文注释: The optional animation played at the FLH at the beginning of the delay before the cannon fires. Use none to disable the pulse ball. This does not disable the delay. Defaults to PULSBALL.

长描述: 赋予属性的单位伴随的动画，就像伊文炸弹那样，动画要注册，动画的所属方为赋予来源的所属方 Duration内强制循环到时擦除，只有仅1帧的动画可以正常使用完整Animation的刷出粒子等效果 （已知Phobos的动画挂武器拓展下会变为附着对象的所属方）
英文注释: The optional animation to play on the affected unit. The animation is attached to the unit and moves along with it. Defaults to none. The animation is removed when the unit is cloaked. The animation is recreated once the unit is uncloaked again. While cloaked, the AttachEffect is still applied, but the effects caused by the animation are not. Note The animation always loops until the effect subsides. LoopCount is ignored.

长描述: 空降仓降落时的尾烟。默认SMOKEY 空降仓进入大气层的动画用[AudioVisual]►AtmosphereEntry= 全局超级武器默认值
变成废墟或者被摧毁直接消失时的动画 被工程师进入时转换“回”正常建筑：
英文注释: An animation played when a building converted to rubble or removed. Defaults to none.

长描述: 修复成建筑时播放的动画 在Ares3.0以前只要被其他建筑 Rubble.Destroyed=调用过的建筑都硬编码具有以下效果 Capturable=no TogglePower=no Unsellable=yes CanBeOccupied=no 如果搭配头猫reshade旧版本使用可能由于部分处理问题使得这些限制“回归”
英文注释: An animation played when a building is recovered or removed. Defaults to none.

长描述: 火风暴启动后的节点动画，使用建筑色盘。默认GAFSDF_A
英文注释: The optional animation played randomly on Firestorm Wall sections when active. This is drawn in the building’s palette. Defaults to GAFSDF_A.

长描述: 启动后时不时冒出来的火柱。默认FSIDLE
英文注释: The optional animation played randomly on Firestorm Wall sections when active. This is drawn in the building’s palette. Defaults to FSIDLE.

长描述: 干掉地面单位后产生的火柱。默认FSGRND
英文注释: The animation to display when an active Firestorm Wall destroys an object on or close to the ground. This is drawn in the animation palette. Defaults to FSGRND.

长描述: 干掉空中单位后产生的火柱，默认FSAIR 地图触发 92和93号触发可以无条件启动或关闭火风暴，并且无限保持在启动状态，不过如果提供火风暴的建筑被摧毁或者因为其他原因，火风暴会像往常一样关闭。触发只能用于非玩家阵营。 注意： AI不会用这个超武。
英文注释: The animation to display when an active Firestorm Wall destroys an object in the air. This is drawn in the animation palette. Defaults to FSAIR.

长描述: 触电死亡时用这个动画，如果不指定就寻找ELECTRO作为触电死亡动画 注意是[AudioVisual]下，不是和原版其他全局死亡动画一样写在[General]下！
英文注释: If InfantryElectrocuted is not defined then the game will search for an animation named ELECTRO, before finally falling back to the second animation like before.

长描述: 矿爆动画。 独立于杀伤使用，即便未设置 TiberiumExplosiveWarhead 仍可生效。
英文注释: Optional animation displayed when Tiberium contained in a unit explodes. Can be used independently of damage delivery; TiberiumExplosiveWarhead needs not be set. Defaults to none.

长描述: 产生的尾烟。默认SGRYSMK1
英文注释: The animation created as smoke trailer. Defaults to SGRYSMK1.

长描述: 默认V3TAKOFF
英文注释: Defines the optional animation played when the missile takes off. Defaults to V3TAKOFF.

长描述: 默认V3TRAIL
英文注释: Defines the optional animation that is used to draw the trailer of this missile. Defaults to V3TRAIL.

长描述: 默认飞机和国家设置中的ParaDrop.Aircraft=相同
英文注释: The type of aircraft that will deliver the units. Defaults to the corresponding country’s ParaDrop.Aircraft=.

长描述: 飞机类型
英文注释: The AircraftType that will be sent as a spy plane. Defaults to SPYP.
